rationale: This scenario requires navigating from the Xbox dashboard through the Guide to a selected game's Game Activity section, then visiting Achievements, Stats, and the official club, verifying game name and content at each stop before returning to the dashboard. The preconditions state the console is on the dashboard with a focused game tile. Lesson L001 revealed that pressing Guide while already open closes it, and that guided navigation can lag. The plan must: (1) verify the current state, (2) open the Guide safely, (3) navigate to Game Activity using closed-loop text navigation, (4) visit each destination with OCR verification, (5) return to dashboard and confirm. All navigation uses guided_navigate_to_text to avoid the lag issue seen in L001.
assumptions: L001-20261015112419: Avoided by using guided_navigate_to_text for all menu navigation instead of blind directional presses, which prevents lag-induced missed presses. The Guide will be opened fresh from the dashboard (not already open), so no replan-induced double-press of Guide will occur.
The console is powered on and showing the Xbox dashboard with a focused game tile
The selected game is installed and represented by the focused dashboard tile
The user is signed in to Xbox
The GIMX session is authenticated (guide_auth special action was run before this scenario)
The capture card is connected and no other application is using it
The Guide overlay is not currently open at the start of this scenario
Pressing the Guide button from the dashboard will open the Guide overlay
The Guide menu structure includes a 'Game Activity' option reachable by navigating right from the initial position
Game Activity contains selectable options for 'Achievements', 'Stats', and 'Go to official club'
Each destination page displays the selected game's name and relevant content
Pressing B will return from any destination back to Game Activity
Pressing B from Game Activity will return to the dashboard
